title: Nobody Saw It
body: The fault ___ have been noticed weeks earlier if anyone had bothered to read the weekly logs, but the file was opened only after the machine finally stopped.

question.explain_tr: Geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş bir imkân için **could have + üçüncü hal** kullanılır.

title: The Only Explanation
body: The lights are on and her coat is still on the chair, so she ___ be somewhere in the building, probably in the laboratory downstairs, where she often works until late.

question.explain_tr: Kanıta dayanan güçlü tahmin için **must** kullanılır: kesin öyledir.

title: A Different Choice
body: If she ___ read the small print before signing, she would not be paying for a service she has never actually used and could not cancel it without paying a fee.

question.explain_tr: Karma koşul cümlesi: geçmişteki koşul için **had + üçüncü hal**, sonucu bugüne bakar.

title: Not The Real Reason
body: The delay was blamed on the weather, ___ the real cause was a supplier who had missed three deadlines in a row, long before the first storm even arrived.

question.explain_tr: İki durumu karşılaştırıp zıtlık kurmak için **whereas** kullanılır.

title: Rarely Seen
body: Rarely ___ a first-year student present at the conference, which is why her twenty minutes attracted so much attention that afternoon from the older researchers sitting in the room.

question.explain_tr: Olumsuz anlamlı 'Rarely' başa gelince devrik yapı gerekir: **do you see**.

title: Worth The Effort
body: The method is worth ___ even though it feels slower at first, because the material stays in your memory for months rather than days and the difference shows clearly in the final exam.

question.explain_tr: 'be worth' kalıbından sonra fiil **-ing** alır: worth trying.

title: Someone Else Did It
body: She had the whole report ___ by a professional editor, which explains why the final version reads so differently from her first draft, even to people who know her writing well.

question.explain_tr: 'have something done' yapısında üçüncü hal gelir: had the report **checked**.

title: On Condition
body: You may use the laboratory at the weekend ___ that you sign the register and leave everything exactly as you found it before you switch off the lights and lock the door.

question.explain_tr: '... şartıyla' anlamı **provided that** ile verilir.

title: Only If
body: The committee will not consider a late application ___ there is a medical report attached to it, and even then the decision takes weeks, because the panel meets only once a month.

question.explain_tr: Olumsuz cümlede '... olmadıkça' anlamı **unless** ile kurulur.

title: Second Thoughts
body: He regretted ___ the offer as soon as he saw how quickly the department filled the position with somebody far less qualified and considerably less interested in the work itself.

question.explain_tr: 'regret + -ing' geçmişte yapılan bir şeye pişmanlık bildirir; 'regret to' ise kötü haber verir.

title: Not Quite Ready
body: By the end of next month the team ___ working on this version for a full year, and the client has still not seen a demonstration that anyone outside the team can actually use.

question.explain_tr: Gelecekteki bir noktaya kadar süregelen iş için **will have been + -ing** kullanılır.

title: Whatever Happens
body: Take a printed copy with you ___ the network is down again, because the office will not accept a phone screen as proof and the deadline will not move for anybody.

question.explain_tr: Olası bir duruma karşı önlem almak için **in case** kullanılır.

title: Anyone At All
body: ___ arrives first is responsible for opening the windows and switching on the machines in the far corner of the room, before the first group arrives at half past eight.

question.explain_tr: Kişi için 'her kim ... ise' anlamı **Whoever** ile verilir.

title: A Small Difference
body: The difference between the two groups was so small ___ the researchers refused to draw any conclusion from a single experiment until two other laboratories had repeated the measurements.

question.explain_tr: 'so + sıfat + that' kalıbı sonuç bildirir.

title: Said Differently
body: He denied ___ the message, although the system clearly showed that it had been opened from his account twice that morning, and the timestamps matched his working hours exactly.

question.explain_tr: deny fiilinden sonra fiil **-ing** alır: denied reading.

title: Both Sides
body: The proposal is expensive; ___, it solves a problem that has been costing the department far more every single year in repairs, delays and unhappy staff every winter.

question.explain_tr: İki zıt bilgiyi bağlamak için **however** kullanılır.

title: What Was Missing
body: ___ the essay lacked was not information but a clear line of argument connecting the paragraphs to the original question that the reader had been asked to consider.

question.explain_tr: Özne görevindeki isim cümleciği **What** ile başlar: What the essay lacked ...

title: Getting Used To It
body: It took her two months to get used to ___ in a language she had only studied from books, but now she barely notices the effort, not even when she is speaking quickly.

question.explain_tr: 'get used to' kalıbındaki to edattır, bu yüzden fiil **-ing** alır.

title: Hardly Anyone
body: Hardly ___ the lecture started when half the room realised they had walked into the wrong seminar entirely and had to walk out again in front of everybody.

question.explain_tr: 'Hardly ... when' kalıbı geçmişte tam bitmiş bir işi anlatır ve **had** ile devrik kurulur.

title: Better Left Alone
body: Rather than ___ the file yourself, send it back to the person who created it, because two people editing it will double the confusion and the version history will become impossible to follow.

question.explain_tr: 'Rather than' başta kullanıldığında genellikle **-ing** biçimi gelir.

title: As Expected
body: The outcome was more or less ___ we had predicted, which was reassuring but also slightly disappointing for everyone hoping for a surprise after eight months of unusually careful preparation.

question.explain_tr: '... olan şey' anlamındaki isim cümleciği **what** ile kurulur.

title: Enough Notice
body: Students are expected ___ the office at least ten days before they leave, otherwise the last month is charged in full, even if the room was left completely empty.

question.explain_tr: 'be expected' edilgen kalıbından sonra **to + fiil** gelir.

title: The Point Of It
body: The rule exists ___ everyone gets a fair share of the equipment, not because the department enjoys collecting forms from tired students that nobody reads until something actually goes wrong.

question.explain_tr: Arkasından özne + fiil geldiği için amaç bağlacı **so that** olmalı.

title: Long Overdue
body: It is high time the university ___ the online system, which has not been updated since the year most current students started school and every department has learned to work around it.

question.explain_tr: 'It is high time' kalıbından sonra geçmiş zaman gelir ama anlam bugüne bakar: **replaced**.

title: Not Only That
body: Not only ___ the deadline moved, but the required format changed as well, and nobody sent a single message about either decision, right up to the day the window closed.

question.explain_tr: 'Not only' başa gelince devrik yapı gerekir; edilgen için **was the deadline moved** olur.
